name: WordPress WXR Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: Open _index.md in the import folder to find links to all imported posts and pages.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. WordPress WXR Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping your blog archive in Obsidian with it.

related.name: Substack Export Import
related.blurb: Import Substack writer exports as notes with post bodies, dates, and publication fields.

related.name: Tag Properties
related.blurb: Browse custom list properties, such as categories, as clickable tags with note counts and Bases filters.

related.name: Word Count Property
related.blurb: Write word count and reading time properties to notes you choose, for sorting in Bases.
